definitions.explanation: A regular payment made toward insurance, a savings plan, or an installment scheme.
The amount of money risked in a bet or gamble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掛|か}け{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{払|はら}っている→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I pay the insurance premium every month.

examples.japanese: {掛|か}け{金|きん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えたい→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The premiums are high, so I want to switch to a different plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掛|か}け{金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You should check the total annual premiums before signing the contract.

examples.japanese: {掛|か}け{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
{掛|か}け{金|きん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ほど⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The larger the stake, the higher the risk.

examples.japanese: {掛|か}け{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧⟦{失|うしな}って→失う：01887_ushinau⟧、⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I lost the entire bet and regretted it.

notes:
A compound of {掛|か}け (betting; installment) and {金|きん} (money). The two senses reflect different uses of {掛|か}ける: paying in installments or staking money on a gamble.

Sense 1 (insurance/installment payments) is the more common usage in everyday life. Japanese insurance discussions frequently use this term when comparing plans and costs.

Note: This word is distinct from {掛|か}け{金|がね}/{掛金|かけがね}, which can also mean a latch or clasp (for doors). The reading かけきん specifically refers to money.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掛|か}け{金|きん}: insurance premium
- {掛|か}け{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay premiums
- {掛|か}け{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to raise the stake/premium
- ⟦{月々|つきづき}→月々：30032_tsukizuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掛|か}け{金|きん}: monthly premiums

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧: insurance premium — the standard formal term for insurance payments
- {賭|か}け{金|きん}: bet, wager — specifically for gambling; written with a different kanji for ⟦{賭|か}け→賭け：19821_kake⟧
- ⟦{積立金|つみたてきん}→積立金：28915_tsumitatekin⟧: savings installment, reserve fund — money set aside regularly for future use
